title: Finite-Particle Convergence Rates for Conservative and Non-Conservative Drifting Models
summary: We analyze finite-particle drifting models for one-step generative modeling. For a conservative velocity given by the difference of the kernel-smoothed data and model scores, a joint-entropy identity yields continuous-time bounds for the smoothed Fisher discrepancy and the squared particle velocity. The finite-particle correction involves reciprocal kernel density estimates. We give local-occupancy conditions and exact expectation bounds, and show that these expectations diverge for full-support initial densities in a shrinking-bandwidth regime.
